M01-CAS: SELECT flges.bez, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.bez ORDER BY COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) DESC
M01-SCH: SELECT flges.bez, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM flges LEFT JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.bez ORDER BY COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) DESC, flges.bez
M01-BIZ: SELECT flges.bez, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.bez ORDER BY COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) DESC
M01-VAG: SELECT flges.bez, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.bez
M02-CAS: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active'
M02-SCH: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM lfz_typ JOIN lfz ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl ORDER BY lfz_typ.mdl
M02-BIZ: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
M02-VAG: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
M03-CAS: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flug JOIN flghf ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf.fh_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND flghf.iata_cd = 'IST'
M03-SCH: SELECT COUNT(flug_id) FROM flug WHERE stat = 'completed' AND abfl_fh = (SELECT fh_nr FROM flghf WHERE iata_cd = 'IST')
M03-BIZ: SELECT flug.abfl_ist, flug.entf_km FROM flghf JOIN flug ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf(fh_nr) WHERE flghf.icao_cd = 'IST' AND flug.stat = 'completed'
M03-VAG: SELECT COUNT(flug.flug_id) FROM flug JOIN flghf ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf(fh_nr) WHERE flghf.bez = 'IST'
M04-CAS: SELECT flghf1.bez AS from, flghf2.bez AS to, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS count FROM flghf AS flghf1 JOIN flug ON flghf1.fh_nr = flug.abfl_fh JOIN flghf AS flghf2 ON flghf2.fh_nr = flug.ziel_fh WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf1.bez, flghf2.bez ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5
M04-SCH: SELECT flghf_1.iata_cd, flghf_2.iata_cd, COUNT(flug.flug_id) FROM flug JOIN flghf AS flghf_1 ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf_1.fh_nr JOIN flghf AS flghf_2 ON flug.ziel_fh = flghf_2.fh_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf_1.iata_cd, flghf_2.iata_cd ORDER BY COUNT(flug.flug_id) DESC LIMIT 5
M04-BIZ: SELECT flug_ladg.ladg_id, COUNT(flug_ladg.ladg_id) AS completed_flights FROM flug JOIN flug_ladg ON flug.flug_id = flug_ladg.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flug_ladg.ladg_id ORDER BY completed_flights DESC LIMIT 5
M04-VAG: SELECT flghf1.bez AS departure, flghf2.bez AS arrival, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS flight_count FROM flghf AS flghf1 JOIN flug ON flghf1.fh_nr = flug.abfl_fh JOIN flghf AS flghf2 ON flghf2.fh_nr = flug.ziel_fh GROUP BY flghf1.bez, flghf2.bez
M05-CAS: SELECT AVG(CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(versp_cd, 4), ':', '') AS INTEGER)) FROM flug WHERE stat = 'completed' AND versp_cd IS NOT NULL
M05-SCH: SELECT lfz.bez, ROUND(AVG((strftime('%s', flug.ank_ist) - strftime('%s', flug.ank_plan)) / 60), 1) AS avg_delay_minutes FROM flghf JOIN lfz ON flghf.fh_nr = lfz.heimat_fh_nr JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz.bez ORDER BY avg_delay_minutes DESC
M05-BIZ: SELECT flges.bez, AVG(flug.versp_min) FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND flug.versp_min IS NOT NULL GROUP BY flges.bez
M05-VAG: SELECT flges.bez FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' ORDER BY flug.abfl_dat DESC LIMIT 1
M06-CAS: SELECT flges.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'cancelled' GROUP BY flges.bez
M06-SCH: SELECT flghf.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) FROM flghf JOIN lfz ON flghf.fh_nr = lfz.heimat_fh_nr JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'cancelled' GROUP BY flghf.bez ORDER BY COUNT(flug.flug_id) DESC
M06-BIZ: SELECT flges.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS cancellation_volume FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'cancelled' GROUP BY flges.bez
M06-VAG: SELECT flges.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS cancellation_count FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'cancelled' GROUP BY flges.bez
M07-CAS: SELECT flges.bez, SUM(betankg.co2_kg) AS total_co2 FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr JOIN betankg ON flug.flug_id = betankg.flug_id GROUP BY flges.bez
M07-SCH: SELECT flges.bez, AVG(betankg.co2_kg / 1000) AS avg_co2_kg FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr JOIN lfz ON flug.lfz_nr = lfz.lfz_nr JOIN betankg ON flug.flug_id = betankg.flug_id GROUP BY flges.bez
M07-BIZ: SELECT flges.bez, SUM(betankg.co2_kg) AS total_co2 FROM flges JOIN betankg ON flges.flges_nr = betankg.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.bez
M07-VAG: SELECT flug.flugnr, SUM(betankg.co2_kg) AS total_co2_emissions FROM flug JOIN betankg ON flug.flug_id = betankg.flug_id
M08-CAS: SELECT flghf.reg, AVG(betankg.preis_usd_l) FROM flghf JOIN betankg ON flghf.fh_nr = betankg.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.reg
M08-SCH: SELECT flghf.reg, ROUND(AVG(betankg.preis_usd_l), 4) FROM flghf JOIN betankg ON flghf.fh_nr = betankg.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.reg
M08-BIZ: SELECT flghf.reg, AVG(betankg.preis_usd_l) FROM flghf JOIN betankg ON flghf.fh_nr = betankg.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.reg
M08-VAG: SELECT flghf.ort, AVG(betankg.menge_kg) FROM flghf JOIN betankg ON flghf.fh_nr = betankg.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.ort ORDER BY AVG(betankg.menge_kg) DESC LIMIT 1
M09-CAS: SELECT flghf.ort, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.ort HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) >= 4
M09-SCH: SELECT flghf.iata_cd, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.iata_cd HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) >= 4
M09-BIZ: SELECT flghf.ort, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr WHERE lgr.flaeche_m2 >= 4000 GROUP BY flghf.ort
M09-VAG: SELECT flghf.ort, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) AS warehouse_count FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.ort ORDER BY warehouse_count DESC LIMIT 10
M10-CAS: SELECT flghf.ort, flghf.bez FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr WHERE lgr.zolllager_kz = 1 GROUP BY flghf.ort, flghf.bez HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) > 1
M10-SCH: SELECT flghf.iata_cd, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr WHERE lgr.zolllager_kz = 1 GROUP BY flghf.iata_cd HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) > 1
M10-BIZ: SELECT flghf.ort, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr WHERE lgr.zolllager_kz = 1 GROUP BY flghf.ort HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) > 1
M10-VAG: SELECT flghf.ort, flghf.bez, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) AS bonded_warehouses FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr WHERE lgr.zolllager_kz = 1 GROUP BY flghf.ort, flghf.bez HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) > 1
H01-CAS: SELECT flges.bez, lfz.kennz, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS completed_flights FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flges.bez, lfz.kennz ORDER BY completed_flights DESC LIMIT 1
H01-SCH: SELECT flghf.bez, lfz.kennz, COUNT(flug.flug_id) FROM flghf JOIN lfz ON flghf.fh_nr = lfz.heimat_fh_nr JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf.bez, lfz.kennz ORDER BY COUNT(flug.flug_id) DESC, lfz.kennz ASC LIMIT 1
H01-BIZ: SELECT flges.bez, lfz.kennz, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS completed_flights FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND lfz.stat = 'active' GROUP BY flges.flges_nr, lfz.lfz_nr ORDER BY completed_flights DESC LIMIT 1
H01-VAG: SELECT flges.bez, lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(sndg.sndg_nr) AS shipment_count FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr JOIN flug_ladg ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug_ladg.lfz_nr JOIN sndg ON flug_ladg.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr GROUP BY flges.flges_nr, lfz_typ.typ_nr ORDER BY shipment_count DESC LIMIT 1
H02-CAS: SELECT flghf.ort, flges.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS landing_count FROM flghf JOIN flug ON flghf.fh_nr = flug.ziel_fh JOIN flges ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf.ort, flges.bez ORDER BY landing_count DESC LIMIT 1
H02-SCH: SELECT flghf.iata_cd, flghf.bez, flges.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) FROM flghf JOIN flug ON flghf.fh_nr = flug.ziel_fh JOIN flges ON flug.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf.iata_cd, flghf.bez, flges.bez ORDER BY COUNT(flug.flug_id) DESC LIMIT 1
H02-BIZ: SELECT flghf.ort, flges.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS completed_arrivals FROM flghf JOIN flug ON flghf.fh_nr = flug.ziel_fh JOIN flges ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY flghf.ort, flges.bez
H02-VAG: SELECT flghf.ort, flges.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS flight_count FROM flghf JOIN flug ON flghf.fh_nr = flug.abfl_fh JOIN flges ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr GROUP BY flghf.ort, flges.bez ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 1
H03-CAS: SELECT rech_kopf.ausst_dat, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS total_invoiced, SUM(SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY rech_kopf.ausst_dat) AS running_total FROM rech_kopf WHERE rech_kopf.ausst_dat LIKE '2025-%' GROUP BY rech_kopf.ausst_dat ORDER BY rech_kopf.ausst_dat
H03-SCH: SELECT SUBSTR(ausst_dat, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(brutto_usd) AS total_brutto, SUM(SUM(brutto_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY SUBSTR(ausst_dat, 1, 7)) AS running_total FROM rech_kopf WHERE ausst_dat LIKE '2025%' GROUP BY month
H03-BIZ: SELECT rech_kopf.ausst_dat, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS monthly_revenue FROM rech_kopf WHERE rech_kopf.ausst_dat LIKE '2025%' GROUP BY rech_kopf.ausst_dat ORDER BY rech_kopf.ausst_dat
H03-VAG: SELECT SUM(zahlg.betr_usd) AS total_revenue FROM rech_kopf JOIN zahlg ON rech_kopf.rech_id = zahlg.rech_id WHERE zahlg.zahl_dat BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
H04-CAS: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_plan) AS month, COUNT(sdg_verfolg.ereig_id) AS flights_completed, AVG(sdg_verfolg.gew_kg) AS avg_weight FROM flug JOIN sdg_verfolg ON flug.flug_id = sdg_verfolg.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND sdg_verfolg.ereig_cd = 'DLV' GROUP BY month
H04-SCH: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist) AS month, flug.stat, LAG(COUNT(CASE WHEN flug.stat = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)) OVER (ORDER BY flug.abfl_ist) - COUNT(CASE WHEN flug.stat = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS diff FROM flug WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist), flug.stat
H04-BIZ: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', abfl_plan) AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights, LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', abfl_plan)) - COUNT(*) AS month_over_month_change FROM flug WHERE stat = 'completed' GROUP BY month
H04-VAG: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_plan) AS month, COUNT(flug_id) AS flight_count FROM flug JOIN flghf ON flug.abfl_plan = flghf.ort GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H05-CAS: SELECT lfz.kennz, AVG(betankg.betank_zeit - betankg.menge_kg / lfz_typ.max_nutzl_kg * 60) AS avg_ground_time FROM lfz JOIN betankg ON lfz.lfz_nr = betankg.lfz_nr JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr JOIN flug ON betankg.flug_id = flug.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND betankg.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz.kennz ORDER BY avg_ground_time ASC LIMIT 5
H05-SCH: SELECT lfz.kennz, AVG((strftime('%s', flug.abfl_ist) - strftime('%s', flug.ank_ist)) / 3600) AS avg_time_diff FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz.kennz ORDER BY avg_time_diff ASC LIMIT 5
H05-BIZ: SELECT lfz.kennz, AVG(flug.abfl_ist - flug.abfl_plan) FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz.kennz ORDER BY AVG(flug.abfl_ist - flug.abfl_plan) DESC LIMIT 5
H05-VAG: SELECT flug.flug_id, MIN(strftime('%s', sdg_verfolg.ereig_zeit) - strftime('%s', flug.abfl_ist)) AS turnaround_time FROM flug JOIN sdg_verfolg ON flug.flug_id = sdg_verfolg.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND sdg_verfolg.ereig_cd = 'ARR'
H06-CAS: SELECT knd_stamm.name1, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS total_invoiced FROM knd_stamm JOIN rech_kopf ON knd_stamm.kunnr = rech_kopf.kunnr GROUP BY knd_stamm.name1 HAVING SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) > (SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) * 0.04 FROM rech_kopf)
H06-SCH: SELECT knd_stamm.name1, AVG(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) / (SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf) AS avg_brutto_percentage FROM knd_stamm JOIN sndg ON knd_stamm.kunnr = sndg.kunnr JOIN rech_kopf ON sndg.sndg_nr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr GROUP BY knd_stamm.name1 HAVING AVG(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) / (SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf) > 0.04
H06-BIZ: SELECT knd_stamm.kto_cd, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS revenue, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) / ( SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf ) * 100 AS share FROM knd_stamm JOIN rech_kopf ON knd_stamm.kunnr = rech_kopf.kunnr GROUP BY knd_stamm.kto_cd HAVING SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) > ( SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf ) * 0.04
H06-VAG: SELECT knd_stamm.name1, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS total_revenue FROM knd_stamm JOIN rech_kopf ON knd_stamm.kunnr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr GROUP BY knd_stamm.name1 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
H07-CAS: SELECT flghf.ort, SUM(betankg.menge_kg) as total_cargo FROM flghf JOIN betankg ON flghf.fh_nr = betankg.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.ort ORDER BY total_cargo DESC LIMIT 5
H07-SCH: SELECT flghf.ort, SUM(sndg.ges_gew_kg / 1000) AS tonnage FROM flghf JOIN flug ON flghf.fh_nr = flug.abfl_fh JOIN flug_ladg ON flug.flug_id = flug_ladg.flug_id JOIN sndg ON flug_ladg.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND flug_ladg.abschn_stat = 'flown' GROUP BY flghf.ort ORDER BY tonnage DESC LIMIT 5
H07-BIZ: SELECT flghf.bez, SUM(sndg.fracht_gew_kg) AS outbound_tonnage FROM flghf JOIN sndg ON flghf.fh_nr = sndg.urspr_fh GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr ORDER BY outbound_tonnage DESC LIMIT 5
H07-VAG: SELECT flghf.ort, COUNT(zoll_anm.anm_id) AS export_count FROM flghf JOIN zoll_anm ON flghf.fh_nr = zoll_anm.fh_nr WHERE zoll_anm.anm_art = 'export' GROUP BY flghf.ort ORDER BY export_count DESC LIMIT 1
H08-CAS: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(flug_id) FROM lfz_typ JOIN flug ON lfz_typ.typ_nr = flug.lfz_nr JOIN flug_ladg ON flug.flug_id = flug_ladg.flug_id JOIN sndg ON flug_ladg.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND flug_ladg.abschn_stat = 'flown' AND flug_ladg.lade_folge = 1 AND sndg.waren_vol_m3 * 167 < flug_ladg.lade_folge * flug_ladg.lade_folge * lfz_typ.max_vol_m3 / 2 GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
H08-SCH: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(*) as completed_flights FROM lfz_typ JOIN lfz ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr JOIN flug ON flug.lfz_nr = lfz.lfz_nr JOIN flug_ladg ON flug_ladg.flug_id = flug.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND flug_ladg.abschn_stat = 'flown' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl HAVING SUM(flug_ladg.ges_vol_m3) > 0.5 * lfz_typ.max_vol_m3
H08-BIZ: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(flug_id) FROM lfz_typ JOIN lfz ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr JOIN flug ON flug.lfz_nr = lfz.lfz_nr JOIN flug_ladg ON flug_ladg.flug_id = flug.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND flug_ladg.abschn_stat = 'flown' AND flug_ladg.uld_typ = 'PAG' AND (flug_ladg.ges_vol_m3 / lfz_typ.max_vol_m3) > 0.5 GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
H08-VAG: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl FROM lfz_typ JOIN sndg ON lfz_typ.typ_nr = sndg.typ_nr JOIN lfz ON sndg.lfz_nr = lfz.lfz_nr JOIN flug_ladg ON sndg.sndg_nr = flug_ladg.sndg_nr WHERE sndg.fracht_gew_kg / lfz_typ.max_nutzl_kg BETWEEN 0.49 AND 0.51
H09-CAS: SELECT lfz.kennz FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr JOIN flghf ON flug.ziel_fh = flghf(fh_nr) WHERE flghf.hub_kz = 1 GROUP BY lfz.kennz HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT flghf.hub_kz) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1)
H09-SCH: SELECT lfz.kennz FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr JOIN flghf ON flug.ziel_fh = flghf.fh_nr WHERE flghf.hub_kz = 1 AND flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz.kennz HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT flghf.fh_nr) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1)
H09-BIZ: SELECT lfz.kennz FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr JOIN flghf ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf.fh_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND flghf.hub_kz = 1
H09-VAG: SELECT lfz.kennz, lfz.msn, flug.flugnr, flug.abfl_ist, flug.ank_ist FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz.lfz_nr HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT flug.flugnr) > 1
H10-CAS: SELECT zoll_anm.zoll_land, COUNT(zoll_anm.anm_id) FROM zoll_anm WHERE zoll_anm.zollsatz_pct > 20 AND zoll_anm.anm_art = 'import' GROUP BY zoll_anm.zoll_land
H10-SCH: SELECT zoll_land, COUNT(*) FROM zoll_anm WHERE anm_art = 'import' AND (zoll_betr_usd + eust_usd) > 0.2 * zollwert_usd GROUP BY zoll_land
H10-BIZ: SELECT zoll_anm.zoll_land, COUNT(zoll_anm.anm_id) FROM zoll_anm WHERE zoll_anm.zollsatz_pct > 20 GROUP BY zoll_anm.zoll_land
H10-VAG: SELECT zoll_anm.zollwert_usd, zoll_anm.zollsatz_pct FROM zoll_anm JOIN bm_param ON zoll_anm.zoll_land = bm_param.param_wert WHERE bm_param.param_schl = 'high_tax_countries'
